high_level_description: The image depicts the aftermath of a landslide in Wayanad, India. The scene is set in a rural area with lush greenery and a few scattered houses. The sky is overcast, contributing to a somber and grim atmosphere. People: Several individuals wearing bright-colored raincoats (yellow, blue, and green) are visible. These appear to be rescue workers or volunteers, actively engaged in clearing debris and assessing the damage. Their presence suggests ongoing rescue operations and efforts to manage the situation. Objects: A partially collapsed building is prominently featured
